[[File:Sickle mould detail.png|left|130px]]
A '''sickle mould''' is a type of mould that can be used together with a [[silver bar]] to create a [[silver sickle]]. One can make a silver sickle at a [[Crafting]] level of 18.

The sickle mould can be purchased from the following [[shop]]s:
*[[Dommik's Crafting Store.|Dommik's Crafting Store]] in [[Al Kharid]]
*[[Jamila's Craft Stall]] in [[Sophanem]]
*[[Rasolo the Wandering Merchant]] west of the [[Fishing Guild]]
*[[Rommik's Crafty Supplies]] in [[Rimmington]]
